summary: Injected URL validation regression allowing javascript: schemes with HTTP 201; student correctly diagnosed that Pydantic URL validation in app/schemas/link.py was bypassed.
evidence: Security regression test failed: test_validation_abuse_strings_return_400[javascript:alert(1)] expected 400 but received 201 Created.
Student accurately hypothesized that Pydantic URL validator in app/schemas/link.py was bypassed or removed, allowing malicious schemes into the system.
Student formulated remediation plan: inspect validator, re-enable strict scheme checks, and re-run test suite.
